entities.summary: Hilma Aparecida Caldeira is a Brazilian retired volleyball player who competed with the Brazil women's national volleyball team at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta. There she claimed the bronze medal with the Women's National Team. She also competed at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona and the 1994 FIVB World Championship in Brazil. On club level she played with L'Acqua di Fiori/Minas.
